Welcome to Rockville Emblem & Merchandise Design

Read project overview

An emblem and merchandise design project for Welcome to Rockville, a rock and metal festival in Daytona Beach, Florida. The visual identity includes a logo emblem, T-shirt, and drawstring bag, using bold graphics and imagery inspired by rock music.
